messages:
Mia (SEO): Quick sync for launch content + webinar landing. Need a concise URL hygiene guide before publish. Items: canonical policy, striplist for query params, UTM naming convention, internal linking map, and redirect plan. Can we align?
Aj: I can sketch canonical rules. Proposal: prefer non-trailing-slash canonical for blog, consistent canonical header for docs.
Sam P: Strong +1. We'll add permanent 301s for current trailing-slash URLs and ensure paginated lists include rel=prev/next and canonical to page 1 where applicable.
Nora - Content: I'll lock down CTA URLs and the webinar utm pattern. Suggest utm_source=redwood and utm_campaign=mar24_webinar. Want the team to agree on exact params.
Kevin (Dev): We can implement middleware to normalize URLs: remove session, amp, and fbclid-type params; enforce canonical Link header. Where should redirect mappings live?
Mia (SEO): Store redirect mappings and striplist in marketing repo under /seo/url-rules.yaml. Sam, take ownership of the redirect PR. Also include schema checklist: Event, WebinarEvent/webinarSchedule, and FAQPage on landing.
Sam P: On it. Middleware snippet for canonical header: ```
res.set('Link', '<' + canonicalUrl + '>; rel=\"canonical\"')
```
I'll add unit tests for param stripping and an e2e smoke test for Link headers.
Aj: Also, follow our internal linking cluster: product overview -> pillar post -> how-to posts. Add `data-link-type` attributes to outbound anchors so analytics can surface anchor-level conversions.
Nora - Content: I'll annotate the draft posts with exact anchor text and target URLs, plus suggested supporting posts. Sharing doc in #marketing-drafts in a few mins.
seo-bot: Reminder: schedule a crawl after PR merges. Last crawl 2024-03-10 found 412 warnings.
Mia (SEO): Can we have these live before next Wednesday's webinar? I want a one-page checklist added into the launch playbook for AE and Ops to verify on publish.
Kevin (Dev): ETA: middleware + redirect PR by Tue EOD provided no blockers.
Sam P: :thumbsup: PR will include tests for param stripping, canonical headers, and a smoke test hitting a sample landing page.
Aj: :eyes: I'll review canonical rules and internal-link mapping once PR is open.
Mia (SEO): Thanks team. I'll assemble the checklist and publish in the launch playbook. Ping me if anything slips or you need examples for schema markup.
